# SPD-029 — Path rule: a case variant of the home path escapes Laws 1 and 5 on macOS

## Brief
map_into_repository compares a Write target with the home (and, since SPD-016, each worktree) by os.path.relpath, which is case-sensitive, and os.path.realpath does not canonicalize case on APFS. On the default case-insensitive filesystem a target spelled with a different-case home prefix, such as /USERS/ERICLUGO/PERSONAL/SPUD/ledger/tickets/SPD-001.md, counts as outside every project root, so the PreToolUse edit hook allows it (and a Bash redirection into it), although it is the same file as the refused ledger/tickets/SPD-001.md. Rooster's HIGH-2 folded case for the part after the root, not for the root itself.

Evidence: Scratch probe (SPD-016/Adirondack, 2026-09-13), a scratch SPUD_HOME under /private/var/folders, Spud's PreToolUse(Write) to ledger/tickets/SPD-001.md: exact path -> exit 0, deny; the same path with the home prefix upper-cased -> exit 0, silent (allowed). Identical on the pre-SPD-016 bin/spud and on the SPD-016 branch; the filesystem reported samefile(home, home.upper()) true. Fix sketch: when case_insensitive_fs(home), compare roots and targets case-folded (or canonicalize each existing prefix through os.listdir/F_GETPATH), with a test in PreEditTest.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus in a worktree (spd-029-path-rule-case), no children: the fix is one function family in bin/spud_ledger.py (map_into_repository, repository_paths, edit_reason) plus tests. Engineer is the persona's own tier. Scope widened past the proposal's case fix to every alias of the home the filesystem honours: case variants, the /System/Volumes/Data firmlink prefix, and Unicode normalization variants, since each is the same escape by another spelling. No reviewer: no Fable today (Eric's budget), and red-first probes of each alias are the proof.

## Outcome
Clearwater (01, engineer, opus) replaced the path rule's spelling match with file identity: map_into_repository walks the target's existing ancestors and matches (st_dev, st_ino) against the home and every worktree, so case variants, NFD spellings, the /System/Volumes/Data firmlink, long s and the Kelvin sign all map into the repository. The audit closed four more aliases on the same path: .CLAUDE/WORKTREES under an exact home, a long-s generated root, a symlink followed by .., and case or symlink spellings of the spud launcher that escaped Law 6. 14 tests red first; suite 443 OK; PreToolUse(Write) median 21.7 to 21.4 ms. Untested on a case-sensitive volume. Proposals became SPD-030 (P1), SPD-031 (P1), SPD-032 (P2). Code on branch worktree-spd-029-path-rule-case; merge is Eric's call.
